title: Visual CoT: Advancing Multi-Modal Language Models with a Comprehensive Dataset and Benchmark for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on visual chain-of-thought reasoning and benchmarking for multi-modal large language models. While it includes standard procedural sections on ethical considerations and societal impacts (e.g., in the checklist and limitations sections), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
